relations.rationale: Git tree materialization (C3) must only unpack commits originating from authorized storage boundaries (C2). Unauthenticated storage must never be materialized.
Execution isolation (C4) requires faithful, uncontaminated materialization on disk (C3) before running any subprocess.
Trust anchor provenance (#319/#322) and hostile-read boundary (#321) are necessary preconditions for safe execution provenance (#301).
Authoritative diff parsing and fragment chunking (C5) rely on authenticated tree OIDs and safe git acquisition (C4/C3).
Outbound DLP sanitization (C6) requires complete and bounded fragment accounting (C5) so all outbound hunks are vetted.
Router receipt validation (C7) binds to the payload digest and request token produced by sanitized outbound dispatch (C6).
Deterministic readiness (C8) can only evaluate verified model observation receipts (C7).
Gate G5 operational composition (C11) integrates all pipeline primitives (C1 through C8) into an unbroken end-to-end flow.
Trusted required checks (#201) touches the host test execution harness and can advance independently of core diff chunking until G5 composition.
Canonical path normalization (#202) defines universal path primitives and can advance in parallel without write collisions.
Target-pack packaging (#203) packages the engine only after G5 operational composition is proven intact.
Dual-target conformance (#204) verifies distribution packs across AgentEscala and InterLeitos.
Pinable release candidate (#205) is produced only when dual-target conformance and all preceding claims are closed.
